```{r, include = FALSE}

df <- fread('./flux_c_met_c_202505_202607.csv')

df$TIMESTAMP <- as.POSIXct( paste(df$TIMESTAMP, "00:00"), format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", tz = "UTC")


# data formatting for flag plots
# Ensure flags are character first
df$co2_flux.flag <- as.character(df$co2_flux.flag)
df$ch4_flux.flag <- as.character(df$ch4_flux.flag)

# Then assign factor with explicit levels
df$co2_flux.flag <- factor(df$co2_flux.flag, levels = c("2","3","4","5"))
df$ch4_flux.flag <- factor(df$ch4_flux.flag, levels = c("2","3","4","5"))

df$H.flag <- factor(df$H.flag, levels = c("2","3","4","5"))

#df$ch4_flux.flag <- as.factor(df$ch4_flux.flag)
```

# Timeseries Plots

Flag = 2 : EP Flag
Flag = 3 : Absolute Limits Filter
Flag = 4 : Rolling MAD Filter
Flag = 5 : Diagnostic filter


```{r, warning=FALSE}
plot_variable <- function(df, variable, clean_col, flag_col,
                          y_limits, y_label, color_map) {

  # -----------------------------
  # TOTAL OVERVIEW
  # -----------------------------

  p <- ggplot(df) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +

    geom_point(
      data = df[!is.na(df[[flag_col]]), ],
      aes(
        x = TIMESTAMP,
        y = .data[[variable]],
        color = .data[[flag_col]]
      ),
      alpha = 0.7
    ) +

    geom_point(
      aes(
        x = TIMESTAMP,
        y = .data[[clean_col]]
      ),
      color = "black",
      alpha = 0.7
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits) +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_map, name = "Cleaning Flag") +

    labs(
      title = paste(variable, "Toolik - Total Overview"),
      x = "Time",
      y = y_label
    ) +

    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )

  print(p)


  # -----------------------------
  # MONTHLY PLOTS
  # -----------------------------

  time_blocks <- unique(
    data.frame(
      year = format(df$TIMESTAMP, "%Y"),
      month = format(df$TIMESTAMP, "%m")
    )
  )

  time_blocks <- time_blocks[order(time_blocks$year,
                                   time_blocks$month), ]

  for (i in 1:nrow(time_blocks)) {

    current_year  <- time_blocks$year[i]
    current_month <- time_blocks$month[i]

    df_month <- df[
      format(df$TIMESTAMP, "%Y") == current_year &
      format(df$TIMESTAMP, "%m") == current_month,
    ]

    if (nrow(df_month) == 0 ||
        all(is.na(df_month[[clean_col]]))) {
      next
    }

    p <- ggplot(df_month) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +

      geom_point(
        data = df_month[!is.na(df_month[[flag_col]]), ],
        aes(
          x = TIMESTAMP,
          y = .data[[variable]],
          color = .data[[flag_col]]
        ),
        alpha = 0.7
      ) +

      geom_point(
        aes(
          x = TIMESTAMP,
          y = .data[[clean_col]]
        ),
        color = "black",
        alpha = 0.7
      ) +

      scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits) +
      scale_color_manual(values = color_map, name = "Cleaning Flag") +

      labs(
        title = paste(variable, "Toolik -", current_month, "/", current_year),
        x = "Time",
        y = y_label
      ) +

      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
      )

    print(p)
  }
}


```

# MONTHLY EB

```{r, warning=FALSE}
# -------------------------------
# Compute net radiation
# -------------------------------
df$Rn <- df$LWIN_6_14_1_1_1.c +
         df$SWIN_6_10_1_1_1.c -
         df$LWOUT_6_15_1_1_1.c -
         df$SWOUT_6_11_1_1_1.c


# -------------------------------
# Compute SHF average
# -------------------------------
shf_cols <- c(
  "SHF_6_37_1_1_1.c",
  "SHF_6_37_2_1_1.c"
)

df$shf_avg <- rowMeans(
  df[, ..shf_cols],
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Both SHF missing = 0
both_missing <- is.na(df[[shf_cols[1]]]) &
                is.na(df[[shf_cols[2]]])

df$shf_avg[both_missing] <- 0


# -------------------------------
# Compute energy balance
# -------------------------------
df$met  <- df$Rn - df$shf_avg
df$flux <- df$H.c + df$LE.c


# -------------------------------
# Extract year and month
# -------------------------------
df$year  <- as.numeric(format(df$TIMESTAMP, "%Y"))
df$month <- as.numeric(format(df$TIMESTAMP, "%m"))


# -------------------------------
# Filter valid observations
# -------------------------------
df_plot <- df[
  !is.na(df$year) &
  !is.na(df$month) &
  is.finite(df$met) &
  is.finite(df$flux),
]


# -------------------------------
# Plot settings
# -------------------------------
x_lim <- c(-200, 500)
y_lim <- c(-200, 500)


# -------------------------------
# Loop through each year
# -------------------------------
unique_years <- sort(unique(df_plot$year))

for (y in unique_years) {

  df_year <- df_plot[df_plot$year == y, ]

  # Require at least 3 observations
  if (nrow(df_year) < 3) next

  # Linear model
  mod <- lm(flux ~ met, data = df_year)

  slope <- coef(mod)["met"]
  r2 <- summary(mod)$r.squared

  # Print statistics
  cat(
    "\n--- Year:", y, "---",
    "\nSlope:", round(slope, 3),
    "\nR²:", round(r2, 3),
    "\n"
  )

  # Plot
  eb_ytd_month <- ggplot(
    df_year,
    aes(x = met, y = flux, color = factor(month))
  ) +

    geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +

    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm",
      color = "blue",
      se = FALSE
    ) +

    geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "red"
    ) +

    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "black") +

    coord_fixed(
      ratio = 1,
      xlim = x_lim,
      ylim = y_lim
    ) +

    scale_color_viridis_d(
      name = "Month",
      breaks = as.character(1:12),
      labels = month.abb,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +

    labs(
      x = expression("Rn - G (W m"^-2*")"),
      y = expression("H + LE (W m"^-2*")"),
      title = paste("Toolik", y, "Energy Balance")
    ) +

    annotate(
      "text",
      x = max(x_lim),
      y = min(y_lim),
      label = paste0(
        "Slope = ", round(slope, 3),
        "\nR² = ", round(r2, 3)
      ),
      hjust = 1.1,
      vjust = -0.5,
      size = 4
    ) +

    theme_bw()

  print(eb_ytd_month)
}

```
# ANNUAL ENERGY FLUX (ATMOSPHERIC)

```{r, warning=FALSE}


# Arrange chronologically
df <- df %>%
  arrange(TIMESTAMP) %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(format(TIMESTAMP, "%Y"))
  )

# Calculate 24-hour rolling means (48 x 30-minute observations)
df <- df %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    H.smoothed = zoo::rollapply(
      H.c,
      width = 48,
      FUN = function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      fill = NA,
      partial = FALSE,
      align = "center"
    ),

    LE.smoothed = zoo::rollapply(
      LE.c,
      width = 48,
      FUN = function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      fill = NA,
      partial = FALSE,
      align = "center"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

p_H_LE <- ggplot(df) +

  theme_bw() +

  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Raw H
 geom_line(
  aes(x = TIMESTAMP, y = H.c, color = "H"),
  linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.2
) +

  geom_line(
  aes(x = TIMESTAMP, y = LE.c, color = "LE"),
  linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.2
) +


  # Smoothed H
  geom_line(
  aes(x = TIMESTAMP, y = H.smoothed, color = "H"),
  linewidth = 0.9
) +

  # Smoothed LE
  geom_line(
  aes(x = TIMESTAMP, y = LE.smoothed, color = "LE"),
  linewidth = 0.9
) +

  scale_x_datetime(
    date_breaks = "1 month",
    date_labels = "%b\n%Y",
    timezone = "UTC"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Time (UTC)",
    y = expression(Flux~"(W/m"^2*")"),
    title = "H & LE Flux — Complete Time Series"
  ) +

  theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
  legend.position = "top"
)

print(p_H_LE)
```

# ANNUAL LONGWAVE IN/OUT

```{r, warning=FALSE}

# 1. Extract year and calculate rolling averages per column before pivoting
# This ensures that gaps are preserved and smoothing does not bleed across years
df_lw_smooth <- df %>%
  arrange(TIMESTAMP) %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(format(TIMESTAMP, "%Y"))) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    # width = 48 corresponds to a 24-hour window if data is 30-minute intervals
    LWIN_smooth  = zoo::rollapply(LWIN_6_14_1_1_1.c,  width = 48, FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE, fill = NA, partial = FALSE),
    LWOUT_smooth = zoo::rollapply(LWOUT_6_15_1_1_1.c, width = 48, FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE, fill = NA, partial = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(TIMESTAMP, LWIN_6_14_1_1_1.c, LWOUT_6_15_1_1_1.c, LWIN_smooth, LWOUT_smooth)

# 2. Pivot the raw data
df_raw_long <- df_lw_smooth %>%
  select(TIMESTAMP, LWIN_6_14_1_1_1.c, LWOUT_6_15_1_1_1.c) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(LWIN_6_14_1_1_1.c, LWOUT_6_15_1_1_1.c),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  )

# 3. Pivot the smoothed data separately so they can be merged cleanly
df_smooth_long <- df_lw_smooth %>%
  select(TIMESTAMP, LWIN_smooth, LWOUT_smooth) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(LWIN_smooth, LWOUT_smooth),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "smoothed_value"
  ) %>%
  # Rename variables to match the raw data for seamless coloring
  mutate(variable = case_when(
    variable == "LWIN_smooth"  ~ "LWIN_6_14_1_1_1.c",
    variable == "LWOUT_smooth" ~ "LWOUT_6_15_1_1_1.c"
  ))

# 4. Join the long dataframes together
df_lw_final <- left_join(df_raw_long, df_smooth_long, by = c("TIMESTAMP", "variable"))

# 5. Plot using geom_line with na.rm = FALSE to force breaks at data gaps
p_lw <- ggplot(df_lw_final, aes(x = TIMESTAMP, color = variable)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  
  # Raw data lines (slightly transparent)
  geom_line(aes(y = value), linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.3) + 
  
  # UPDATED: Smooth lines that automatically cut off during data gaps
  geom_line(aes(y = smoothed_value), linewidth = 1, na.rm = FALSE) + 
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("LWIN_6_14_1_1_1.c" = "firebrick", "LWOUT_6_15_1_1_1.c" = "dodgerblue"),
    labels = c("Incoming LW", "Outgoing LW"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = expression(Longwave~Radiation~"(W/m"^2*")"),
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 8)
  ) +
  scale_x_datetime(
    date_breaks = "1 month",
    date_labels = "%b"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    title = "Longwave Radiation In/Out"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

print(p_lw)



```

# ANNUAL GROUND HEAT FLUX 

```{r, warning=FALSE}

df_filtered <- df %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    TIMESTAMP >= as.POSIXct("2025-07-02 00:00:00", tz = "UTC")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(TIMESTAMP) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    G = rowMeans(
      cbind(SHF_6_37_1_1_1.c, SHF_6_37_2_1_1.c),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    G = ifelse(is.nan(G), NA_real_, G),

    G.smoothed = zoo::rollapply(
      G,
      width = 48,
      FUN = function(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      fill = NA,
      partial = FALSE,
      align = "center"
    )
  )
p2 <- ggplot(df_filtered, aes(x = TIMESTAMP)) +

  # Individual SHF measurements
  geom_line(
    aes(y = SHF_6_37_1_1_1.c, color = "SHF 1"),
    linewidth = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +

  geom_line(
    aes(y = SHF_6_37_2_1_1.c, color = "SHF 2"),
    linewidth = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +

  # Raw mean G
  geom_line(
    aes(y = G, color = "Mean G"),
    linewidth = 0.5,
    alpha = 0.25
  ) +

  # Smoothed mean G
  geom_line(
    aes(y = G.smoothed, color = "G 24h rolling mean"),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    name = expression(Soil~Heat~Flux~(W/m^2)),
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 8),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.05)
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "SHF 1" = "firebrick",
      "SHF 2" = "darkgreen",
      "Mean G" = "blue",
      "G 24h rolling mean" = "black"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +

  scale_x_datetime(
    date_breaks = "1 month",
    date_labels = "%b %Y",
    timezone = "UTC"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "",
    title = "Soil Heat Flux — Individual Measurements and Mean G"
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}


plot_monthly_soil_air <- function(df, tz = "UTC") {
  
  #
  
  # 2. Add month and year columns if they are not already present
  if (!"month" %in% names(df)) {
    df <- df %>% mutate(month = as.numeric(format(TIMESTAMP, "%m")))
  }
  if (!"year" %in% names(df)) {
    df <- df %>% mutate(year = as.numeric(format(TIMESTAMP, "%Y")))
  }
  
  # 3. Get unique combinations of year and month, sorted chronologically
  time_blocks <- df %>% 
    distinct(year, month) %>% 
    arrange(year, month)
  
  # 4. Loop through each specific year and month combination
  for (i in 1:nrow(time_blocks)) {
    current_year  <- time_blocks$year[i]
    current_month <- time_blocks$month[i]
    
    # Filter data for this specific year and month
    df_month <- df %>% 
      dplyr::filter(year == current_year & month == current_month)
    
    # Check if ALL soil and air temperature columns are entirely NA in this block
    # (Updated to check the newly merged TS_2_38_2_2_1 column)
    temp_cols <- c("TS_2_38_1_1_1.c", "TS_2_38_1_2_1.c", "TS_2_38_1_3_1", "TA_2_1_1_1_1.c")
    valid_cols <- intersect(temp_cols, names(df_month))
    
    if (nrow(df_month) == 0 || (length(valid_cols) > 0 && all(sapply(df_month[valid_cols], function(x) all(is.na(x)))))) {
      next
    }
    
    # ------------------------------- 
    # Soil Temperature Plot 
    # ------------------------------- 
    p_soil <- ggplot(df_month) + 
      theme_bw() + 
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") + 
      geom_line(
        aes(x = TIMESTAMP, y = TS_2_38_1_1_1.c, color = "8 cm"), 
        linewidth = 0.8, na.rm = FALSE
      ) + 
      geom_line(
        aes(x = TIMESTAMP, y = TS_2_38_1_2_1.c, color = "18 cm"), 
        linewidth = 0.8, na.rm = FALSE
      ) + 
      # UPDATED: Now plotting the newly consolidated 28 cm column
      geom_line(
        aes(x = TIMESTAMP, y = TS_2_38_1_3_1, color = "28 cm"), 
        linewidth = 0.8, na.rm = FALSE
      ) + 
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c("8 cm" = "blue", "18 cm" = "green", "28 cm" = "gold3"), 
        breaks = c("8 cm", "18 cm", "28 cm"), 
        name = NULL
      ) + 
      labs(
        x = "", 
        y = expression("Temperature ("*degree*C*")"), 
        title = paste0("Soil Temperatures — ", current_month, "/", current_year)
      ) + 
      theme(legend.position = "top")
    
    # ------------------------------- 
    # Air Temperature Plot 
    # ------------------------------- 
    p_air <- ggplot(df_month) + 
      theme_bw() + 
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") + 
      geom_line(
        aes(x = TIMESTAMP, y = TA_2_1_1_1_1.c), 
        color = "red", linewidth = 0.8, na.rm = FALSE
      ) + 
      labs(
        x = "", 
        y = expression("Temperature ("*degree*C*")"), 
        title = paste0("Air Temperature — ", current_month, "/", current_year)
      )
    
    # ------------------------------- 
    # Stack and print 
    # ------------------------------- 
    print(p_soil / p_air)
  }
}


plot_monthly_soil_air(df)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
# 1. Pad timeline across the ENTIRE dataset to prevent artificial year-end breaks
df_rh_smooth <- df %>%
  arrange(TIMESTAMP) %>%
  # Fill timeline gaps seamlessly across all years
  complete(TIMESTAMP = seq(min(TIMESTAMP), max(TIMESTAMP), by = "30 min")) %>%
  mutate(
    # Rolling calculation over the continuous timeline (no group_by)
    RH_smooth = zoo::rollapply(
      RH.c, 
      width = 240,     # 5-day window
      FUN = mean, 
      na.rm = FALSE,   # Breaks smoothing line if actual data gaps exist
      fill = NA, 
      partial = FALSE  
    )
  )

# 2. Relative Humidity Plot with continuous multi-year x-axis
p_rh <- ggplot(df_rh_smooth, aes(x = TIMESTAMP)) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = RH.c), alpha = 0.5, color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.7) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = RH_smooth), color = "blue", linewidth = 1) + 
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Relative Humidity (%)", 
    limits = c(0, 100), 
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 10)
  ) + 
  # Dynamic x-axis formatting for continuous multi-year tracking
  scale_x_datetime(
    date_breaks = "1 month", 
    date_labels = "%b-%Y"  # Formats as 'Jan-2025', 'Feb-2025', etc.

  labs(
    x = "", 
    title = "Relative Humidity"
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
# 0. Define the cutoff threshold date
cutoff_date <- as.POSIXct("2026-05-01 00:00:00", tz = "UTC") # from when going from 7500 pres. to HMP 

# =========================================================================
# 1. Merge Sensors Chronologically and Calculate Deep Rolling Smooth
# =========================================================================
df_pres_smooth <- df %>%
  arrange(TIMESTAMP) %>%
  mutate(
    combined_pressure = ifelse(TIMESTAMP < cutoff_date, air_p_mean.c, PA_4_2_1_1_1.c),
    year = as.numeric(format(TIMESTAMP, "%Y"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    # UPDATED: width = 336 corresponds to a 7-day window for 30-minute data.
    # Increase this number further if you want an even smoother line (e.g., 672 for 14 days)
    pres_smooth = zoo::rollapply(combined_pressure, width = 336, FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE, fill = NA, partial = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# =========================================================================
# 2. Plotting with Gaps Forced (na.rm = FALSE)
# =========================================================================
p_pres <- ggplot(df_pres_smooth, aes(x = TIMESTAMP)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  
  # Raw merged data line (slightly transparent, gray)
  geom_line(aes(y = combined_pressure), color = "gray40", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.6, na.rm = FALSE) +
  
  # Highly smoothed trend line that still drops off during gaps
  geom_line(aes(y = pres_smooth), color = "black", linewidth = 0.8, na.rm = FALSE) +
  
  geom_vline(xintercept = cutoff_date, col = 'blue', linetype = 'dashed') +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Air Pressure (kPa)",
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 8)
  ) +
  scale_x_datetime(
    date_breaks = "1 month",
    date_labels = "%b %Y"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    title = "Air Pressure"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

print(p_pres)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
# 3. Loop: print separate plot for each distinct month-year window

  current_month <- timeline_blocks$month_name[i]
  
  # Filter data for this specific chronological block

      legend.position = "top"
    )
  
  print(p_month)
}
```

```{r, warning=F, echo=FALSE}
  group_by(year, month, hour) %>%
 dplyr:: summarise(
    rad_mean  = mean(SWIN_6_10_1_1_1, na.rm = TRUE),
    rad_sd    = sd(SWIN_6_10_1_1_1, na.rm = TRUE),
    rpot_mean = mean(rpot, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

month_list <- diel_rad %>%
  distinct(year, month) %>%
  arrange(year, month)

for(i in 1:nrow(month_list)) {
  
  y <- month_list$year[i]
  m <- month_list$month[i]
  
  dfm <- diel_rad %>%
    dplyr::filter(year == y, month == m)
  
  p <- ggplot(dfm) +
    
    # rpot line (like original blue line)
    geom_line(aes(hour, rpot_mean),
              color = "blue",
              linewidth = 0.8) +
    
    # measured radiation mean
    geom_line(aes(hour, rad_mean),
              linetype = 2) +
    
    # variability ribbon
    geom_ribbon(aes(
      x = hour,
      ymin = rad_mean - rad_sd,
      ymax = rad_mean + rad_sd
    ),
    alpha = 0.3) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 23, by = 3)) +
    
    labs(
      title = format(as.Date(paste(y, m, 1, sep = "-")), "%B %Y"),
      x = "Hour of Day",
      y = "Radiation (W m⁻²)"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal()
  
  print(p)
}
```

```{r, warning=F, echo=FALSE}

# 1. Parse timestamps safely and extract chronological blocks
df_time <- df %>%
 dplyr:: mutate(
    TIMESTAMP_true = as.POSIXct(TIMESTAMP, tz = "UTC"),
    year = as.numeric(format(TIMESTAMP_true, "%Y")),
    month = as.numeric(format(TIMESTAMP_true, "%m")),
    month_name = factor(month, levels = 1:12, labels = month.abb)
  )

# Get unique year-month blocks present across your entire dataframe
timeline_blocks <- df_time %>%
  distinct(year, month_name) %>%
  arrange(year, month_name) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(month_name))

# Common styling variables
lbl_y_temp <- expression("Temperature ("*degree*C*")")
lbl_y_vwc  <- expression("Soil Moisture VWC (m"^3*"/m"^3*")")
color_map  <- c(
  "Center" = "black", 
  "East"   = "firebrick", 
  "West"   = "dodgerblue4", 
  "North"  = "forestgreen", 
  "South"  = "gold3"
)

# =========================================================================
# LOOP THROUGH EACH YEAR & MONTH BLOCK INDIVIDUALLY
# =========================================================================
for (i in 1:nrow(timeline_blocks)) {
  current_year  <- timeline_blocks$year[i]
  current_month <- timeline_blocks$month_name[i]
  
  # Filter master dataset down to the single month block
  df_month <- df_time %>% 
    dplyr::filter(year == current_year, month_name == current_month)
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # HORIZON 1: +15cm Air Temperature
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  df_p1 <- df_month %>% 
   dplyr:: filter(!is.na(TMS_C_T_1) | !is.na(TMS_E_T_1) | !is.na(TMS_W_T_1) | !is.na(TMS_N_T_1) | !is.na(TMS_S_T_1))
  
  # SAFEGUARD: Skip plotting completely if the month contains no row records
  if (nrow(df_p1) >= 2) {
    p1 <- ggplot(df_p1, aes(x = TIMESTAMP_true)) +
      theme_minimal() +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
      geom_line(aes(y = TMS_C_T_1, color = "Center"), linewidth = 0.7, na.rm = FALSE) +
      geom_line(aes(y = TMS_E_T_1, color = "East"),   linewidth = 0.7, na.rm = FALSE) +
      geom_line(aes(y = TMS_W_T_1, color = "West"),   linewidth = 0.7, na.rm = FALSE) +
      geom_line(aes(y = TMS_N_T_1, color = "North"),  linewidth = 0.7, na.rm = FALSE) +
      geom_line(aes(y = TMS_S_T_1, color = "South"),  linewidth = 0.7, na.rm = FALSE) +
      scale_color_manual(values = color_map, name = "Logger Station") +
      scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 week", date_labels = "%b %d, %Y") +
      labs(x = "", y = lbl_y_temp, title = paste("TMS Network: +15cm Air Horizon —", current_month, current_year)) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), title = element_text(face = "bold"))
    
    print(p1)
  }

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # HORIZON 2: 0cm Ground Surface Temperature
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  df_p2 <- df_month %>% 
   dplyr:: filter(!is.na(TMS_C_T_2) | !is.na(TMS_E_T_2) | !is.na(TMS_W_T_2) | !is.na(TMS_N_T_2) | !is.na(TMS_S_T_2))

      geom_line(aes(y = TMS_S_T_2, color = "South"),  linewidth = 0.7, na.rm = FALSE) +
```
